bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Gold Token SA issues DGLD natively on Ethereum, Base, and Solana; the Ethereum and Base token proxies are administered by separate issuer EOAs, while the Solana Token-2022 mint is listed in the issuer registry. No current third-party bridge carries the Ethereum or Base representations; the Solana deployment is reviewed as a native route. On February 23, 2026, the former Ethereum-Base bridge allowed phantom deposits and unauthorized unbacked minting on Base; the path was frozen, legacy Base balances were migrated one-for-one, the old Base contract was deprecated, the bridge was closed on June 30, 2026, and the replacement Base token was independently allocated gold-backed. Gold Token SA completed the legacy Base balance reset on July 15, 2026. This retired-bridge incident remains adverse historical Bridge Risk evidence and does not describe current native issuance.

routes.reviewNote: Issuer-native deployment: the ethereum DGLD token is a transparent proxy whose EIP-1967 admin and MINTER_ROLE/DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE resolve to Gold Token SA issuer EOAs (mint-authority review 2026-07-16, verified). No third-party bridge mints this deployment.

Issuer-native deployment: the base DGLD token is a transparent proxy whose EIP-1967 admin and MINTER_ROLE/DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE resolve to Gold Token SA issuer EOAs (mint-authority review 2026-07-16, verified). No third-party bridge mints this deployment.

Gold Token SA's official contract registry lists this DGLD Token-2022 mint on Solana; Solscan confirms the live mint and CoinGecko maps the DGLD asset to the same address. Reviewed as a native issuer deployment; no third-party bridge route is asserted.
